_readme: Merge-only fragments for the mem MCP server. This file is not itself a client config; copy the section that matches your client.

Claude Code: merge the object under "claudeCode" into the top-level mcpServers of ~/.claude.json (user scope) or of .mcp.json in the project root. Or run: claude mcp add-json mem '<the claudeCode.mcpServers.mem object>' --scope user
opencode: merge the object under "opencode" into ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json (its mcp key).
Adjust the command path if the checkout moves; mem is not installed on PATH.
MEM_ROOT defaults to ~/.agents/memory; the project store is resolved from the server process's working directory, or from MEMORY_PROJECT_CWD when the client sets it.
No autoMemoryEnabled and no hooks here: those belong to the hooks/opencode agents.
